reviews.comment: Class split 50/50 with Merlin. Really not a great prof but could've been worse. Slideshows were a bit disorganized and info was hidden behind meaningless illustrations or examples. Lectures were not as good as Merlin either.

Lectures are soooo boring and slideshows are pretty unhelpful. She was very caring and understanding though. Class taught 50/50 with Dr. Merlin who was much better so if you can choose between them, take Merlin. Grades were 100% from the 4 exams which were non-cumulative an dhad 3 EC questions each. Go to SI and study with quizlet for an easy A.
